messages:
alex: PTAL — I pushed updates for the schema change in PR #3421. Addressed the payload -> payload.v2 split, added a compatibility shim, included a migration script, and updated the rollout doc (docs/runbooks/schema-rollout.md). Smoke steps are in the PR description. Need one approver to schedule canary.

maria: Looking now. Quick question — did you keep the old payload parsing for 30 days?

alex: yes, added a feature flag `enable_payload_v2` and a compatibility path that checks for `payload.v2` then falls back. Migration script marks `migrated=true` in customer metadata.

sam: can you paste the smoke commands here? want to run locally before canary.

alex: sure — run these:```bash
# apply migration to staging
python tools/migrate_payload.py --env=staging --limit=100
# start local shim
docker-compose up shim
# smoke request
curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"payload.v2": {"text":"hello"}}'
```

maria: skimmed PR, a couple tiny nits on the doc (link formatting + one example JSON), otherwise LGTM. I'll approve after you fix the example.

alex: fixed the example. pushed a doc patch and a tiny test.

ops-bot: Canary window open: 14:00-16:00 UTC today (auto-reserve). To claim merge custody, reply "claim" within the hour.

devon: I can take merge custody at 14:10 UTC. Claiming now.

sam: thanks devon — i'll run the smoke checklist at 14:05 and report back.

alex: thanks all. tagging @maria for the final approve when you have a moment. :raised_hands:

maria: Approved and left a thumbs up reaction. :thumbsup:

alex: merging on devon handoff window. will monitor metrics for first 30m and have fallback to `v1` shim if errors > 1%

devon: got it, will watch. ping here with any alerts.

sam: smoke passed in staging, looks clean. no regression on tokenization.

alex: perfect — merging now. will follow up with post-rollout note in #eng and update the runbook if anything weird shows up.
